summary.text: Epeian captain who followed Meges son of Phyleus in the battle at the ships — distinct from the Epeian captains of the Catalogue and from Dracius elsewhere in later myth.

story.text: When the wall was breached and the fight raged where the ships of Ajax and Protesilaus lay, the Epeians were led by Meges son of Phyleus, and Araphion and Dracius followed in the press of battle among the stout-hearted warriors.
